title: Geometry and Dynamics
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with the National Higher School of Mathematics, Algeria
about: CIMPA research school on geometry and dynamics at Sidi Abdellah, Algiers, 23 May-3 June 2027, organised with the National Higher School of Mathematics. Applications go through the CIMPA application site and close 23 January 2027.
requirements: CIMPA schools are aimed mainly at students and teacher-researchers in developing countries
Applications must be made via the CIMPA application site before the deadline on the school's page
